dogecoin.text: @elonmusk @ChainLinkGod @PeterMcCormack Mining centralization mostly has to do with the nature of PoW, and nothing to do with any Bitcoin SHA 256 chain. PoW has the consequences of economies of scale, which are fundamentally unavoidable unless you want to change Dogecoin to PoS.
